description: Return three distinct, Omoro-grounded brand routes for a user. First translate only supported personal taste signals into numeric taste_axes, include the exact known palette and known brand_context, then call this tool. Each route includes an automatically selected style blend, signature visuals, positioning and message framework, and voice guidance. Use Omoro for the page frame only; let each blend's defining features lead its route. Present all three as choices and do not invent missing brand facts or collapse the options into one generic style.

avoid_styles.description: Style slugs the user or brand has rejected or already overuses.

brand_context.description: Known, user-provided brand facts Muse may use for positioning and messaging. Omit unknown fields; the tool will leave them as open inputs.

brand_palette.description: Exact brand colors as six-digit hex codes. When supplied, all three directions must stay within these colors.

taste_axes.description: Infer only axes supported by the user's known context. Each is -1 to 1. Poles: minimal_maximal (- minimal, + maximal); analog_digital (- analog, + digital); expressive_restrained (- restrained, + expressive); warm_cool (- cool, + warm); futuristic_nostalgic (- futuristic, + nostalgic); structured_chaotic (- structured, + chaotic); light_dark (- dark, + light); organic_geometric (- organic, + geometric).

analog_digital.description: Target position on the analog_digital axis, -1 to 1.

expressive_restrained.description: Target position on the expressive_restrained axis, -1 to 1.

futuristic_nostalgic.description: Target position on the futuristic_nostalgic axis, -1 to 1.

light_dark.description: Target position on the light_dark axis, -1 to 1.

minimal_maximal.description: Target position on the minimal_maximal axis, -1 to 1.

organic_geometric.description: Target position on the organic_geometric axis, -1 to 1.

structured_chaotic.description: Target position on the structured_chaotic axis, -1 to 1.

warm_cool.description: Target position on the warm_cool axis, -1 to 1.

name: suggest_style_directions
